title: International Medical Insurance (Peso and Dollar-denominated Plan)

sections.html:
International Medical Insurance (Peso and Dollar-denominated Plan)

A letter of guarantee for cashless availment abroad may be arranged for confinement cases.

What are the information/documents needed for International Medical Insurance? 

  • With Existing Plan

- Copy of the contract/schedule of benefits
- 9-month utilization report
- List of employees and dependents with date of birth, civil status, and current plan cover
- Broker of Record (BOR) – form will be provided by Trinity

  • Virgin account

- Preferred plan benefits, if possible
- List of employees and dependents with date of birth and civil status
- Broker of Record (BOR) – form will be provided by Trinity
